profile.name: Arnav Sanghavi
profile.tagline: The Coalition (Microsoft) · Gears of War: E-Day
profile.roleTitle: Technical Gameplay Designer & Gameplay Systems Engineer
profile.roleDesc: Technical Gameplay Designer & Gameplay Systems Engineer at The Coalition Studio (Microsoft). Specializing in C++ gameplay architecture, NPC behavior systems (StateTree / Smart Objects), systemic spawning, and player locomotion across Unreal Engine and Unity.
aboutParagraphs: I have always been fascinated by games for as long as I can remember. That curiosity naturally evolved into a deep passion for technical gameplay design and C++ systems engineering — architecting systemic mechanics, authoring intelligent NPC behaviors, and building tools that bridge creative design visions with performant engine code.

Currently at The Coalition Studio (Microsoft) contributing to Gears of War: E-Day, I specialize in architecting runtime NPC behavior frameworks (StateTree, Smart Objects), systemic spawning pipelines, and native C++ gameplay conversion. Prior to this, I programmed gameplay and optimized multiplayer systems at BL!NK MEDIA INC on FEI Equestriad World Tour.
I thrive in high-collaboration studio environments where engineering, design, and animation intersect to create tactile, unforgettable player experiences.

experience.summary: Lead technical design and C++ implementation of core systemic mechanics, NPC behaviors, and actor population pipelines for AAA production.
bullets: Owned the architecture and runtime optimization of NPC behavior systems, implementing modular AI frameworks (StateTree, Smart Objects) to power dense, low-latency background populations in live builds.
Spearheaded the technical design and optimization of all in-game systemic spawning mechanics, taking full end-to-end ownership of development and maintenance.
Oversaw technical design and optimization of equipment and inventory systems, utilizing data-oriented design fundamentals to drastically reduce CPU overhead and frame-time constraints.
Partnered directly with engineering to lead native C++ conversions of critical gameplay systems, profiling CPU, memory, and runtime bottlenecks with LOD and culling strategies.
Served as primary technical point-of-contact for gameplay systems, authoring comprehensive architecture documentation and unblocking cross-discipline workflows.

experience.summary: Engineered gameplay systems, movement controllers, and technical pipelines across live-service mobile and PC titles.
bullets: Optimized multiplayer gameplay systems, weapon mechanics, and character locomotion, reducing CPU/network overhead and improving responsiveness by 15%.
Took sole ownership of an inherited, undocumented legacy codebase; refactored unoptimized systems to integrate scalable data-oriented mechanics with zero downtime.
Delivered a fully functional modular AI agent prototype within a strict one-month sprint, achieving runtime performance gains integrated into the production build.
Authored technical documentation and workflow architecture guides for Unity and Unreal, accelerating engineering onboarding and reducing troubleshooting time by 30%.
Assisted designers with visual scripting and custom tools, implementing 5 new systemic mechanics while aligning design goals with performant code.

experience.summary: Full-lifecycle multiplayer architecture, engine migration, and core character controller engineering.
bullets: Engineered a high-performance multiplayer system using Photon, and successfully migrated the entire project from Unreal 5 to Unity in under 30 days with minimal downtime.
Optimized system architecture and introduced Git / Gitflow version control, reducing development turnaround time by 25% and boosting collaboration efficiency by 30%.
Co-authored the main player controller and dynamic camera systems, improving player movement responsiveness and retention by 15%.
Prototyped interactive UI systems and player workflows that increased user engagement by 20%.

education.summary: Rigorous, studio-simulated game development program emphasizing low-level C++ programming, engine mechanics, systemic AI, and cross-discipline collaboration.
bullets: Rapidly prototyped and delivered 10+ complete games in Unreal Engine and Unity under strict weekly constraints.
Engineered custom level design tools that increased layout efficiency by 800%, allowing the generation of 5 levels in 30 minutes.
Created custom stealth locomotion, camera shake systems, and AI perception trees for final graduation project AZAD.

education.role: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (B.Sc. IT)
education.summary: Comprehensive foundation in computer science, software engineering, algorithms, data structures, object-oriented programming, and computer networking.

projects.title: FEI Equestriad World Tour

projects.title: AZAD
projects.desc: A cooperative stealth game set during the 1925 Kakori Train Robbery in British-occupied India. Players control freedom fighters Chandrashekhar Azad and Ram Prasad Bismil, coordinating infiltration and treasure recovery without combat detection.
projects.workflow: Built in Unreal Engine 5 using a hybrid C++ and Blueprints architecture. Engineered player locomotion and dynamic camera shake systems. Designed AI perception and patrol state trees for train guards, ensuring high tension where silent team communication and timing are the only path to survival.

media.caption: AZAD - Official Trailer (Co-Op Stealth in UE5)

projects.title: Rolling Slime
projects.desc: A tactile physics puzzle game where players guide a shape-shifting slime to the target portal by physically tilting the screen and changing between liquid and solid states.
projects.workflow: Engineered in Unity using custom 2D/3D physics interactions. Created phase transition mechanics: colliding with ice freezes the slime into a low-friction solid, while heat/fire liquefies it to squeeze through narrow crevices. Designed reactive HUD indicators and screen-tilting controls.

media.caption: Rolling Slime - Playthrough & Mechanics

projects.title: Jungle Jumpers: 3...2..1. Banana
projects.desc: An adventure puzzle game crafted for the '3...2..1.' Game Jam. Hop your way through challenging spatial grids, outsmarting patrolling enemies and timing obstacles.
projects.workflow: Engineered grid-based player navigation, interactive hazard timing state machines, and level progression logic in Unity. Built responsive grid-movement interpolation and reactive audio feedback under strict 48-hour game jam constraints.

media.caption: Jungle Jumpers - Gameplay Demonstration

projects.title: World of Ball
projects.desc: A 3D spatial exploration puzzle game where players guide a lone traveler trapped in a portal loop, navigating curved landscapes to gather orbs while avoiding self-intersecting trails.
projects.workflow: Developed 3D physics-based sphere controller, momentum dampening, orb collection triggers, and portal teleportation logic in Unity. Programmed snake-like hazard trails that penalize backtracking.

media.caption: World of Ball - Gameplay Walkthrough

projects.title: Meme Forest
projects.desc: A first-person survival horror game utilizing real-time microphone input. Players must physically make vocal noise to replenish their courage gauge and outrun forest horrors.
projects.workflow: Integrated Unity's microphone input API to sample acoustic frequency and volume thresholds in real-time. Designed courage-depletion loops, player stamina coupling, and proximity-based audio panic events.

media.caption: Meme Forest - Audio-driven Gameplay

projects.title: Ball Again
projects.desc: A fast-paced, deceptive indie platformer filled with sneaky traps and troll mechanics designed to keep players constantly adapting to unexpected hazards.
projects.workflow: Designed and programmed precision 2D ball physics, instantaneous respawn state loops, deceptive obstacle triggers, and physics-driven hazard timing in Unity. Published for WebGL browser play.

media.caption: Ball Again - Fast-paced troll platformer

projects.title: Pixi Racer
projects.desc: A split-screen multiplayer obstacle racer where two players race neck-and-neck through dynamic hazard-filled courses to reach the checkpoint first.
projects.workflow: Implemented local split-screen camera logic, high-responsiveness arcade vehicle controls, collision impulses, dynamic screen shake triggers, and real-time obstacle hazards.

media.caption: Pixi Racer - Split-screen competition

projects.title: Troopers
projects.desc: An endless runner game where players collect friends and march together in formation down busy streets while dodging oncoming traffic.
projects.workflow: Programmed the core squad-formation locomotion algorithm, spacebar brake/resume mechanics, dynamic mouse-velocity scaling, procedural traffic spawner, and collision game-over states in Unity.

media.caption: Troopers - Squad-based endless runner

projects.title: Chicken's Breakout
projects.desc: A hybrid arcade title fusing classic Breakout brick-shattering with Space Invaders projectile shooting, featuring invading chickens with counter-attacks.
projects.workflow: Engineered dual gameplay mechanics: paddle ball-bouncing physics alongside real-time player laser shooting. Implemented enemy wave spawning, chicken projectile dodging, and lives management in Unity.

media.caption: Chicken's Breakout - Breakout mixed with Space Invaders

projects.title: Angry Old Ben
projects.desc: A fast-paced endless beat-'em-up developed in Unreal Engine 4 where players control Uncle Ben fighting through overwhelming waves of street enemies to survive and chase high scores.
projects.workflow: Collaborated with team to program responsive brawler melee hitboxes, combo animations, enemy horde AI aggregation, knockback physics, and scoring multiplier systems in Unreal Engine 4.

media.caption: Angry Old Ben - Endless beat-'em-up brawler in Unreal Engine 4

projects.title: Chess 2
projects.desc: A reimagined chess strategy game featuring pre-game custom board drafting and custom units including Bombers, Wizards, and modified King movement.
projects.workflow: Engineered custom board tile coordinate systems, legal move evaluation rules for fantasy piece types, draft placement state machines, and turn-based victory condition evaluation.

media.caption: Chess 2 - Strategic custom pieces & drafting

projects.title: FIND A WAY OUT
projects.desc: A stylized Gameboy-aesthetic 2D maze exploration game where the player navigates labyrinths by shifting path polarities between black and white against a ticking clock.
projects.workflow: Created monochrome palette rendering pipeline, grid path collision shifting, time-attack countdown systems, and Gameboy-style retro controller constraints.

media.caption: FIND A WAY OUT - Gameboy Retro Maze

projects.title: Bright The Brave
projects.desc: A 2D puzzle platformer featuring an inverted/indirect input control twist that forces players to rethink classic jumping mechanics.
projects.workflow: Developed custom 2D character controller with non-traditional input mapping, jump curve physics, hazard collision triggers, and level reset checkpoints in Unity.

media.caption: Bright The Brave - 2D platformer with input twist

projects.title: Leviathan Axe Recall
projects.desc: God of War-inspired Leviathan Axe throw, lodge-in-surface, and physical bezier curve recall mechanic developed in Unity.
projects.workflow: Engineered custom projectile trajectory with surface normal alignment on collision in Unity. Quadratic Bezier curve calculation with dynamic camera impulse and physical recall catch.

media.caption: Leviathan Axe - Throw, Impact & Bezier Recall in Unity

projects.title: Brick Spanner Tool
projects.desc: Procedural level design editor tool in Unity that enables level designers to rapidly generate complex modular brick walls with randomized surface damage and curvature.
projects.workflow: Engineered as a custom in-editor tool in Unity C#. Exposes user-configurable parameters: row count, brick spacing, curvature, and randomized noise seeds for procedural placement.

media.caption: Brick Spanner - Procedural Wall Generation in Unity

projects.title: Toon Cel-Shader
projects.desc: Custom stylized cel-shading lighting model with discrete stepped diffuse bands, customizable specular highlights, and outline edge detection.
projects.workflow: Authored in Unity ShaderLab with HLSL. Features multi-step light ramp evaluation, rim lighting for silhouette pop, and silhouette outline extrusion.

media.caption: Stylized Toon / Cel Shader Lighting

projects.title: Curved World Horizon Shader
projects.desc: Real-time GPU vertex displacement shader that bends the world mesh around the camera to simulate a miniature planet or stylized curved horizon without altering world physics collisions.
projects.workflow: Displaces vertices in world space based on distance from the camera viewpoint using quadratic curvature equations, maintaining high performance and batching compatibility.

media.caption: Curved World Horizon vertex bending effect

projects.title: Air Hockey CV Controller
projects.desc: Interactive 2D Air Hockey game where player paddle controls are mapped to a real-world colored object tracked live via webcam through OpenCV color thresholding.
projects.workflow: Integrated OpenCV image processing pipeline with Unity. Streams webcam feed, isolates target HSV color ranges, calculates center-of-mass centroid coordinates, and smoothly interpolates paddle physics positions.

media.caption: OpenCV Color Tracking Controller
